title: Gate suite renames v1
description: units/<id>/gate-suite-renames.json (D-067, plan v3 U1): the baseline tests a unit renamed or moved, keyed by the Vitest project each one left. A retained test cannot leave the gate (D-069 item 5); a rename says which live test replaced it. scripts/generate gate-suite-renames joins every unit's file into the one table scripts/lib/gate_suite.py reads, so no pull request edits a shared list.

row.description: [project, file, test title], all strings: the identity of one test in the suite listing.
